args.prompt: <image-1> is a plain computer render (a clay render) of the living room of a new apartment in the Rainbow tower, Tel Aviv. Re-render it as a photograph taken from exactly the same camera: the same position, angle, lens and crop, every wall, ceiling, floor plane, door, window frame and the glass slider at exactly the same pixel position, nothing added, removed or moved. <image-2>, <image-3>, <image-4> are photographs of the SAME apartment (its 360° tour, already furnished in its final design): copy their materials, furniture style, colours, light and mood exactly, never their framing, EXCEPT the floor: ignore the tiled floor of the reference photos, the floor of this image is a wide-plank natural oak parquet floor, matte, pale honey tone, long planks laid lengthwise, no gloss, one continuous surface across the whole apartment, no tiles and no grout lines anywhere. The look: a wide-plank natural oak parquet floor, matte, pale honey tone, long planks laid lengthwise, no gloss; the floor meets the walls with NO skirting board (a clean shadow-gap line, no baseboard); warm white plastered walls; a flat warm white ceiling with slim recessed spots and a linear warm LED cove; a micro-cement feature wall in warm greige behind the TV; zero-line interior doors (full-height, frameless, flush with the wall, no architrave, no panels, painted the wall colour, a slim matte black lever); a bulthaup kitchen with handleless matte sand-grey lacquer fronts and a thin brushed stainless-steel worktop; slim black-framed floor-to-ceiling glazing with sheer off-white linen curtains; the furniture of the reference photos: a cream boucle curved sectional sofa, a round pale travertine coffee table, a woven jute round rug, a cream boucle swivel armchair, a low sand-grey lacquer TV unit, a round light-oak dining table with cream upholstered chairs under a white paper pendant, olive trees in stone planters on the terrace. Every plain furniture piece of <image-1> becomes a designer piece of the same size at the same place in that style (the sofa becomes the cream boucle sectional, the armchair the cream swivel chair, the TV unit the low sand-grey lacquer unit, the coffee table the round travertine table), keeping the floor layout of <image-1>. Soft bright morning daylight. Photoreal, sharp, natural colours. No people, no text, no logos, no watermark.

result.prompt: A sharp, photorealistic interior photograph of the exact living room in <image-1>, keeping the identical camera position, angle, lens, framing, wall planes, ceiling, window frames, right-hand glass slider frame, and furniture placement of <image-1>, rendered with the materials, furniture design, palette, and soft bright morning daylight of <image-2>, <image-3>, and <image-4>.
